newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Five SKorean firms apply for initial public offers.
newsitem.headline: Five SKorean firms apply for initial public offers.

text.p: Five South Korean firms have applied for initial public offerings, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Tuesday.
The applications will be reviewed in April, it said in a statement.
Pusan City Gas Co Ltd, to offer 2.7 million shares at 18,000 won per share.
Sewon Heavy Machinery Co Ltd, to offer 767,143 shares at 14,000 won per share.
Duck Yang Industry Co Ltd, an auto parts maker, to offer 420,000 shares at 19,000 won per share.
Moorim Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd, to offer 690,000 shares at 10,000 won per share.
Kong Hwa Co Ltd, an auto parts manufacturer, to offer 293,000 shares at 20,000 won per share.
